title: Fees for professional or technical services, royalty, and non-compete fees

effectivePeriod.sunsetNotes: Transitions to Section 393(1), Table 1, Sl. No. 6(iii) of the Income-tax Act, 2025 effective 1 April 2026, where the threshold increases from ₹30,000 to ₹50,000 per financial year.

plainTextSummary: Deduction of tax at source on professional and technical payments to resident payees. (1) Statutory Rates: (a) Fees for Technical Services (FTS) under Section 194J(1)(a) / Section 393(1), Table 1, Sl. No. 6(iii).D(a): 2%; (b) Fees for Professional Services: 10%; (c) Royalty for cinematographic films: 2%; (d) Other royalties and non-compete fees: 10%; (e) Director fees: 10% with zero threshold. (2) Threshold: Under Section 194J of the 1961 Act, ₹30,000 per financial year per statutory category. Under Section 393(1), Table 1, Sl. No. 6(iii) of the 2025 Act (w.e.f. 1 April 2026), the threshold increases to ₹50,000. (3) Classification Invariants: Professional services are strictly defined under Section 44AA(1) (legal, medical, engineering, architecture, accountancy, technical consultancy, interior decoration, IT); FTS is defined under Explanation 2 to Section 9(1)(vii) (managerial, technical, or consultancy services). (4) Reclassification Risk & Penalties: If services deducted at 2% (FTS) are recharacterized on assessment as Section 44AA(1) professional services (10%), the deductor is liable for differential withholding tax, penal interest under Section 201(1A), and 30% expenditure disallowance under Section 40(a)(ia).

keyStatutoryThresholds.technicalServicesDefinition: Explanation 2 to Section 9(1)(vii) of Income-tax Act, 1961 (managerial, technical, or consultancy services)
keyStatutoryThresholds.professionalServicesDefinition: Section 44AA(1) of Income-tax Act, 1961 (notified professions: legal, medical, engineering, architectural, accountancy, technical consultancy, interior decoration, IT professionals)
keyStatutoryThresholds.penalInterestSection201_1A: 1% per month for delay/shortfall from date deductible; 1.5% per month from date deducted to date deposited
keyStatutoryThresholds.disallowanceSection40_a_ia: 30% expenditure disallowance for failure to deduct or deposit TDS
keyStatutoryThresholds.cbdtCircular23GstExclusion: TDS applies on basic service amount excluding separately stated GST.
